objective_breakdown: stage2: low_temperature_retention>=0.95 (capacity(-20C)/capacity(25C), hard metric, driven by Chen2020 Arrhenius i0 (neg E~35kJ/mol -> x0.081 at 253K if fully cooled) + lumped-thermal cooling; electrolyte sigma/D are T-independent in Chen2020 (measured) so transport levers act uniformly; energy_density_wh_kg>=327.18 (calc-energy contract, baseline ~400 headroom); energy_density_wh_l>=880 (baseline ~850, needs inactive-layer thinning). stage3 protocol defaults: plated=false, T_max_K<=333.15 on 4C_charge_45C, triggered=false.
candidate_strategy: R1 baseline Chen2020 (no overrides): 1C/lowT/4C45+plating/calc-energy + opening ceiling assessment. R2 electrolyte formulations (sigma/D/t+ bridge, low-viscosity ester basis, Smart1999/Zhang2002/Xu2004) + architecture variants (small particle radius -> charge-transfer, thin separator/CC -> Wh/L). R3+ combine winners, iterate retention to 0.95 while tracking ED via calc-energy; thermal h direction decided by evidence (insulation for retention vs cooling for 4C exam); system switch (OKane2022/LNMO) only on evidence.
budget_allocation: R1 ~4 runs; R2 ~12; R3+ ~12; Stage4+closing ~4; total ~32 runs, SPMe quick-screen, DFN final confirmation only
risk_and_fallback: retention unreachable -> diagnose scale: charge-transfer (particle radius/system) vs transport (sigma/D/t+) vs cell-cooling (h insulation); ED_wh_l shortfall -> separator/CC thinning; thermal tension retention-vs-4C -> record operating envelope verbatim, no threshold fiddling; three-strike -> escalation questions (system reachability / boundary / metric reachability).

detail: R1 = baseline characterization (start_stage 2, but no molecular candidates this round). Base determination: task text names no electrode system -> anchor-table default Chen2020 (NMC811/graphite); verified by dump (93 keys, NMC811/graphite signature: particle radii 5.22/5.86 um, densities 3262/1657 kg/m3). Materials props source: baseline (parameter-set literature values). Opening ceiling assessment: levers = electrolyte sigma/D/t+ (T-independent in Chen2020, act uniformly), particle radius (charge-transfer + solid diffusion path), electrode/separator/CC thickness + porosity (transport path, Wh/L), thermal h (cell cooling). Ceiling estimate: ED_kg 400 (objective 327, 22% headroom), ED_L 843 (objective 880, gap +4.3% -> thin separator/CC alone projects ~898), retention 99.4% (objective 95%, large headroom; Chen2020 T-independent electrolyte/solid transport limits low-T penalty to Arrhenius i0 + cell cooling), 4C plating (anode min -0.44 V -> fail; fix via transport+particle levers), T_max 332.4 K (0.8 K margin -> thin CC raises risk, small-particle/thin-electrode heat reduction offsets). No material bottleneck: ED gaps are architecture-scale; retention gap does not require material invention -> no escalation to Stage 2 molecular invention needed; electrolyte formulation candidates still proposed in R2 as the low-T transport design lever.
